claims.claim: Researchers at the University of British Columbia and the University of Toronto identified the posterior ocular lymphatic outflow pathway in mice.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the University of British Columbia and the University of Toronto identified the posterior ocular lymphatic outflow pathway in mice.
claims.source_title: The eye has a hidden cleanup system scientists never knew existed
claims.supporting_quote: A team from the University of British Columbia (UBC) and the University of Toronto has identified a previously unrecognized drainage route called the posterior ocular lymphatic outflow, or POLO pathway.

claims.claim: The nuclear clock maintained steady operation for more than twenty-four hours without reference to an atomic clock.
claims.episode_span: Researchers showed steady operation for more than twenty-four hours in the initial tests.
claims.source_title: Scientists build a nuclear clock that could make atomic clocks obsolete
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers have demonstrated that it can operate steadily for more than 24 hours without intervention.

claims.claim: Polyethylene accounts for roughly one-third of global plastic production.
claims.episode_span: Polyethylene accounts for roughly one-third of global plastic production and appears in food packaging and containers.
claims.source_title: A plastic once thought harmless may be fueling fatty liver disease
claims.supporting_quote: Polyethylene accounts for approximately one-third of plastic production worldwide.

claims.claim: The NEOPRISM-CRC trial followed thirty-two patients for nearly three years with no recurrences after pre-surgery pembrolizumab.
claims.episode_span: After nearly three years of follow-up, no patient experienced recurrence.
claims.source_title: Bowel cancer melted away after immunotherapy, then stayed away
claims.supporting_quote: After nearly three years of follow-up, none of the patients had experienced a cancer recurrence, including those who still had small traces of disease after treatment.
